# Data Integrity Checklist: SPEC-009C4 - Owner Merge Gate and Done Reconciliation

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for exact PR identity, fail-closed reconciliation, idempotent manual sync, label/status projection, and bounded evidence integrity.
**Created**: 2026-05-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required task and GitHub identity fields complete enough to prove the exact linked repo, issue, and PR before `done`? [Completeness, Spec FR-004, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Contract Preconditions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are fail-closed requirements complete for closed issues without matching merged PR evidence, missing PR evidence, unmerged linked PR evidence, and mismatched repo or PR evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, Spec FR-006, Spec FR-007, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK003 Are duplicate-sync requirements complete for terminal outcome uniqueness, downstream launch uniqueness, terminal activity bounds, notification bounds, and cleanup idempotency? [Completeness, Spec FR-009, Spec FR-010, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Contract Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK004 Are label and status projection requirements complete for moving from `ready_for_owner` to `done`, applying or observing done projection, and removing stale ready-for-owner projection? [Completeness, Spec FR-011, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Contract Successful Side Effects]
- [ ] CHK005 Are live-smoke data integrity requirements complete for distinguishing fixture evidence from real GitHub evidence and forbidding reuse of SPEC-009C3 PR #49? [Completeness, Spec FR-013, Spec FR-014, Spec FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is authoritative merged PR evidence clearly defined as explicit merged truth for the exact linked PR rather than supporting fields such as issue-closed state, labels, `merged_at`, or `merge_commit_sha` alone? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Contract Completion Rule]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the `ready_for_owner` to `done` completion rule stated with clear preconditions covering `G_PILOT_MERGE`, manual GitHub sync, exact identity, and verified merged PR truth? [Clarity, Spec FR-002, Spec FR-003, Spec FR-004, Contract Preconditions]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the distinct reconciliation-required evidence reasons clear enough to separate missing, unmerged, mismatched, closed-only, and fixture-only evidence cases? [Clarity, Spec FR-007, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK009 Are duplicate-sync side-effect limits clear enough to distinguish one terminal outcome from permissible repeated sync observations? [Clarity, Spec FR-009, Spec FR-010, Spec SC-004, Contract Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the SPEC-009D evidence handoff clear about which existing fields and rows carry task, PR, label, activity, notification, artifact, and smoke-checklist evidence? [Clarity, Spec FR-012, Spec Clarifications Session 4, Data Model SPEC-009D Evidence Handoff]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the spec, plan, data model, and contract consistently require the existing manual GitHub sync path rather than polling, webhooks, scheduler behavior, or a new sync API? [Consistency, Spec FR-003, Spec FR-017, Plan Constraints, Contract Out Of Scope]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the status-transition requirements consistently keep the task in `ready_for_owner` for all insufficient evidence cases and move it to `done` only after exact merged PR truth? [Consistency, Spec SC-001, Spec SC-002, Spec SC-003, Data Model PR-Producing Pilot Task]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the label/status projection requirements align with the terminal activity and task-chain requirements so that `advanceTaskChain` runs only after verified `github_pr_merged` evidence? [Consistency, Spec FR-009, Spec FR-011, Plan Summary, Contract Successful Side Effects]
- [ ] CHK014 Do fixture-boundary requirements consistently allow mocked evidence only in automated tests while requiring real GitHub state for live smoke proof? [Consistency, Spec FR-015, Spec Assumptions, Contract Test Fixture Boundary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can the exact PR identity requirement be objectively verified from named repo, issue, PR, task, workspace, and project fields? [Measurability, Spec FR-004, Spec SC-005, Spec Clarifications Session 3]
- [ ] CHK016 Can fail-closed negative cases be objectively measured as 100% remaining `ready_for_owner` with reconciliation-required evidence? [Measurability, Spec SC-003, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK017 Can duplicate sync idempotency be objectively measured as one terminal outcome and zero duplicate downstream launches after at least two repeated syncs? [Measurability, Spec SC-004, Spec FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Can label/status projection be objectively verified from done status, done label projection, stale ready-for-owner projection removal, terminal activity, and sync evidence? [Measurability, Spec FR-011, Spec SC-005, Contract Successful Side Effects]
